title: Vintage Ceramic Christmas Village “Toys” Shop Building – Light-Up House – Snowy
descriptionText:
Add a charming, nostalgic touch to your holiday village display with this vintage ceramic “Toys” Shop building. This piece features a snow-covered roof, stone-style walls, red window trim, and a tall tower detail—perfect for Christmas village collectors or seasonal decorators.
This building has an opening on the bottom for placing a small light or LED to create a warm, festive glow.
